title: Cauliflower with poppy seeds, coconut cream and chilli

source.title: Yotam Ottolenghi's warming winter vegetable recipes

instructions: Soak the poppy seeds in 2 tbsp boiling water for 30 minutes, then crush in a mortar for a minute to break some up. Thinly slice the garlic, break the cauliflower into 4cm florets keeping any tender leaves, toast the almonds, chop the coriander, and juice one lime to get 1 tbsp.
Heat the oil in a large sauté pan with a lid over a medium-high heat. Fry the spices, garlic and salt for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until the garlic starts to brown and the spices are aromatic.

Add the cauliflower and leaves and cook, stirring all the time, for 2 minutes until coated. Stir in the coconut cream and poppy seeds, turn down to medium, cover and cook for 4 minutes until starting to soften.
Uncover, turn up to medium-high and cook for 7 to 8 minutes more, stirring a few times, until the liquid has gone and the cauliflower is caramelised.
Off the heat, stir in the coriander, almonds and lime juice. Serve with lime wedges.
